title: A dev profile that keeps endpoints open during front-end work

objectives.text: Define a dev-profile SecurityFilterChain that permits all requests and allows the local front-end origin with CORS, active only when the dev profile is on
Prove that the default profile still enforces authentication by running the security tests without the dev profile
Explain the risk of shipping an open profile and how profile activation and startup checks prevent it
